Substrate.label: Substrate code (every world)
Substrate.explain: Fixed code every world runs through: the Engine, compiler, run loop, service, records.

Family.label: Fixed people-world part
Family.explain: Fixed code every people world gets from compile_spec.py; the group-decision family is added when the description has a decision.

PerWorld.label: Written per world by an AI
PerWorld.explain: Not code: an AI writes it for each described world during the build.

Reference.label: Waltzman reference code only
Reference.explain: Hand-written code for the Waltzman reference world; no generated world uses it.

Theory.label: In documents only
Theory.explain: Named in decisions or the roadmap, not on the live path.

nodes.label: World
nodes.explain: The one canonical world during a run: entities with typed components, a tick and a revision. Code: src/world_substrate/engine.py.

nodes.label: Engine
nodes.explain: Applies each attempt atomically or refuses it with a recorded reason; runs due processes each tick. Code: src/world_substrate/engine.py:558.

nodes.label: Event
nodes.explain: The record of one attempt or process step: status, checks, changes, an id like r14-e00012. Code: src/world_substrate/engine.py:505.

nodes.label: Move (action)
nodes.explain: Something a person may try; its rule has checks and effects, compiled before use. Code: src/world_substrate/action_authoring.py:367.

nodes.label: Process
nodes.explain: A rule the world runs by itself each tick when its checks hold. Code: src/world_substrate/engine.py:762.

nodes.label: Compiler
nodes.explain: Turns proposed rules into installed rules and derives what each may read and write. Code: src/world_substrate/action_authoring.py:367.

nodes.label: Approval record
nodes.explain: A person's yes to the rules, stored with the rules' profile id and world fingerprint; every round names it. Code: scripts/world_builder_service.py:418.

nodes.label: World fingerprint
nodes.explain: A short hash of the bundle and rules that ties builds, rounds and shares to one world. Code: scripts/world_builder_service.py:381.

nodes.label: Information item
nodes.explain: A piece of information with a source and per-recipient deliveries; hidden until delivered. Code: src/world_substrate/information.py:57.

nodes.label: Run loop
nodes.explain: Each round: everyone decides, picks are submitted in a rotating order, then processes run. Code: scripts/run_authored_world.py:460.

nodes.label: Lost race
nodes.explain: When an earlier pick changed the state, a later pick is resubmitted or re-chosen once; if nothing is left the person gets nothing_left and is not told why. Code: scripts/run_authored_world.py:536.

nodes.label: Resident
nodes.explain: One Concordia AI agent per person: sees its brief, memory and what it can see, answers belief, move, expected effect and work. Code: scripts/concordia_residents.py:29.

nodes.label: Task
nodes.explain: A watched field value that takes several rounds, started by a person or the world, ended by a process: finished or failed part-way. Code: scripts/attempts.py:17.

nodes.label: Finished-task notice
nodes.explain: What the other people a finished task names are told, in the starter's own words about the work. Code: scripts/attempts.py:234.

nodes.label: Build
nodes.explain: Description to spec, actions, rules, assembly, scripted test run and score. Code: scripts/world_builder_service.py:1538.

nodes.label: Rules retry
nodes.explain: A second rules attempt after a rejection or weak score; skipped after 80 s. Code: scripts/world_builder_service.py:263.

nodes.label: Scripted test run
nodes.explain: The build's free run with simple moves that scores the rules and lists long tasks and whether each can fail part-way. Code: scripts/world_builder_service.py:1607.

nodes.label: Run log
nodes.explain: One line per request with its trace ids, cost and full artifacts; the source for shares and trace reads. Code: scripts/world_builder_service.py:478.

nodes.label: Readout
nodes.explain: One AI summary of a run whose every cited event id is checked against the run. Code: scripts/run_readout.py:125.

nodes.label: Share link and replay
nodes.explain: A saved run rebuilt from the run log that a visitor replays with no AI calls. Code: scripts/world_builder_service.py:598.

nodes.label: Daily allowance
nodes.explain: Visitor $3/day, owner $5/day; spend fails closed. Code: scripts/world_builder_service.py:51.

nodes.label: People world
nodes.explain: A world built from a description about people: people, information, moments and the fixed people rules. Code: scripts/people_world.py:225.

nodes.label: Communicate rule
nodes.explain: The reviewed move that delivers an information item to its recipient. Code: spikes/any-scenario-2026-10/compile_spec.py.

nodes.label: Scheduled moment
nodes.explain: A countdown that happens every so many rounds (a weekly meeting, a deadline). Code: spikes/any-scenario-2026-10/compile_spec.py:48.

nodes.label: Work cycle
nodes.explain: Each action at most once per person per cycle of at least 3 rounds. Code: spikes/any-scenario-2026-10/compile_spec.py:517.

nodes.label: Group decision
nodes.explain: A decision with support, deadline, deployment and review; changed only by fixed rules. Code: spikes/any-scenario-2026-10/compile_spec.py:86.

nodes.label: Concern
nodes.explain: An objection a group holds on a delivered item: open, under remedy or resolved, with answered and remedy_by. Code: spikes/any-scenario-2026-10/compile_spec.py:70.

nodes.label: Support
nodes.explain: A member's stance on the decision: none, full or conditional on a concern. Code: spikes/any-scenario-2026-10/compile_spec.py:66.

nodes.label: Remedy
nodes.explain: A fix of a concern that takes 2 rounds; it can be stopped part-way by the concern's holder objecting. Code: spikes/any-scenario-2026-10/compile_spec.py:332.

nodes.label: Agenda count
nodes.explain: group_decision.agenda_items: a bare number of matters put before the decision; an item has no content. Code: scripts/people_world.py:279.

nodes.label: Rollout
nodes.explain: The deployment the world starts when the decision is authorized: 6 rounds, suspended if support falls. Code: spikes/any-scenario-2026-10/compile_spec.py:399.

nodes.label: Operating review
nodes.explain: Every 6 rounds after deployment; may reopen each resolved concern once. Code: spikes/any-scenario-2026-10/compile_spec.py:442.

nodes.label: Person and brief
nodes.explain: A person the spec names, with goals and beliefs, and the brief only their own resident reads. Code: scripts/people_world.py:355.

nodes.label: Generated actions and rules
nodes.explain: The moves and processes the fixed parts do not cover, written by the rules-writing AI and compiled. Code: scripts/people_world.py:260.

nodes.label: Waltzman reference components
nodes.explain: Trust, risk, readiness and commitment components and analyses of the hand-written Waltzman world. Code: reference_worlds/waltzman/components.py:11.

nodes.label: Build in an agent harness
nodes.explain: Decision 008: worlds built by an agent that drafts, checks and edits; scripts/world_harness.py exists but the live service does not call it. Code: scripts/world_harness.py.
